nightly-evals-bot: nightly RAG eval finished for main/nightly @here
nightly-evals-bot: regressed: retrieval R@1 -14.2%, R@5 -9.7% vs baseline (yesterday) — see summary https://ci.redwood/reports/nightly/1769126789
maria: whoa that's huge. any idea if this is reranker or embeddings drift?
josh: quick look: embedding drift metrics show mean cosine down 0.03 on prod-corpus. But reranker score distribution also shifted — more ties > top1 margin smaller.
kai: pinged infra: vector DB upgraded last night to vecdb v2.1. Could index change (cosine->ann-tuned) be affecting recall? @sre-ops any deploys?
sre-ops: we rolled vecdb 2.1 at 01:12 UTC, change log: switched default ANN index params (ef=64). No model changes on infra side.
maria: reranker PR #462 merged 4 hours ago — adjusted pairwise loss weighting (lambda=0.7 -> 0.5). Could reduce re-rank sharpness.
josh: reproduced locally by running eval with yesterday's reranker weights vs current:
```
python eval/rag_eval.py --index prod-sample --reranker models/reranker-v3 --split nightly
# baseline (v2 weights): R@1 0.58 R@5 0.82 MRR 0.70
# current (v3 weights):    R@1 0.50 R@5 0.74 MRR 0.63
```
this matches the regression magnitude.
maria: interesting — embedding cosine drop would lower recall uniformly, but reranker shift explains top1 collapse. Both combined explains bigger hit.
oliver: any quantization or bring-up of a new embedder model? I saw a quantize job yesterday but not sure target.
josh: quantize job was for small-prototypes branch, not prod. But reranker v3 was trained after switching tokenization normalization; could change similarity calibration.
kai: immediate triage checklist: 1) roll back reranker PR to v2 on canary 2) re-index a sample with old vecdb params 3) run head-to-head eval with both changes 4) collect per-query failure samples.
maria: I'm running step 3 now on a 10k sample. uploading logs to <https://ci.redwood/artifacts/1769126789/partial>
nightly-evals-bot: job started: eval-run-1769126790 (10k sample)
josh: also let's dump reranker scores and embedding cosines for failed queries, e.g.:
```
query_id,embed_cosine_top1,embed_cosine_top5_mean,rerank_score_top1,rerank_delta
q12345,0.67,0.58,0.31,-0.02
q12346,0.59,0.61,0.12,-0.18
```
maria: early results: when reranker is rolled back R@1 recovers ~0.56 (partial) — so reranker is the main culprit. Combined with vecdb ef tuning it makes the worst cases.
kai: plan then: revert merged PR for reranker v3 in prod canary, schedule a retrain with original loss weighting + tokenization normalization checks, and open a vecdb ticket to pin index params for nightly eval cluster.
oliver: I'll draft the rollback PR and notify platform for canary window.
sre-ops: copied, scheduling rollback at 10:30 UTC.
maria: saving failure set for model team: attached 120 queries with verbose logs to the ticket.
josh: follow-ups: - add a check in nightly-evals that compares reranker score distribution percentile shifts and alerts >5% change - add an integration test that runs a small re-rank baseline after index upgrades.
maria: agreed. will create follow-up issues and owners. :white_check_mark:
nightly-evals-bot: thread closed (next run in 24h)
